Introduction

As Thanksgiving approaches, it’s the perfect time to send warm wishes to friends and loved ones who can’t be with you at the table. Whether you want to share a heartfelt message or add a touch of humor, expressing your gratitude through a Thanksgiving greeting is a great way to spread joy. From funny one-liners to thoughtful notes, we’ve compiled over 90 creative Thanksgiving message ideas. Use these to connect with family, friends, or anyone special this holiday season and show them how much they mean to you.

Why Send Thanksgiving Text Messages to Customers?

Thanksgiving provides a unique opportunity to express gratitude to our customers and strengthen our business relationships. Simple text messages can communicate appreciation and enhance connections in a meaningful way. Our customers play a vital role in our success, and letting them know this during a time of gratitude can reinforce positive feelings and build loyalty.

In a busy and competitive market, staying connected with customers is essential. Happy Thanksgiving message serve as a gentle reminder of how much we value their support. By doing this, we not only acknowledge their role in our story but also keep our brand in their minds in a pleasant and memorable way.

The Advantages of SMS Communication

  • Immediate Reach: SMS messages are typically read within minutes of being received, ensuring our gratitude messages are promptly seen.
  • High Engagement: With high open and response rates, SMS offers an effective way to engage customers directly without overwhelming them.
  • Personal Touch: Personalizing messages by including the customer’s name or referencing past interactions makes the communication feel more genuine and considerate.

Building Stronger Relationships Through Gratitude
Thanking customers fosters goodwill and strengthens emotional bonds, boosting loyalty and encouraging positive word-of-mouth. Personalizing messages shows customers they’re valued, not just transactions.

Enhancing Brand Image and Loyalty
Gratitude enhances a brand’s image, making it more approachable and human. Sending festive, heartfelt messages creates positive associations and strengthens customer loyalty.

Strategic Timing and Messaging
Timing matters—sending Thanksgiving messages close to the holiday sets a warm tone for future interactions. Short, genuine messages are effective and easily absorbed during the holiday rush.

Encouraging Engagement and Reciprocity
Encourage interaction by including a call to action, like sharing Thanksgiving moments with a branded hashtag, fostering community engagement.

Utilizing Technology for Effective Outreach
With the right tools, personalized mass messaging becomes seamless, allowing for targeted outreach while maintaining a personal touch. Technology helps track interactions and tailor future communications.

Key Elements for Crafting Effective Messages

A successful Thanksgiving message should include the following:

  • Authenticity: Messages should sound genuine and reflect the unique voice of our brand.
  • Brevity: Keeping messages concise helps maintain the reader’s attention and conveys respect for their time.
  • Relevance: Customizing messages based on customer segments or past interactions makes them more relatable and meaningful.

Crafting and sending Happy Thanksgiving messages might seem like a small gesture, but it can have significant benefits for our business relationships. This holiday season, let’s take the opportunity to show our gratitude and strengthen the bonds that keep our business thriving.

25 Ways to Send Thanksgiving Wishes to Clients

Here are some Thanksgiving text message templates designed for businesses to express gratitude and promote good cheer. These can help in building and nurturing relationships during the holiday season.

5 Tailored Thanksgiving Greetings

Create personalized messages that focus on each customer’s unique connection with us. These texts can make recipients feel valued and integral to our community.

  • We want to extend a heartfelt Thanksgiving greeting to you, [Customer Name]. Thank you for being an amazing part of our journey this year. Enjoy the holiday with your loved ones!
  • Hello [Customer Name], wishing you a joyous Thanksgiving! We’re thrilled to have you in our community. Share your festive moments using #OurBrandThanksgiving!
  • Happy Thanksgiving, [Customer Name]! We appreciate your loyalty and how it makes our work meaningful.
  • Greetings [Customer Name], in this season of gratitude, THANK YOU for being with us. Happy Thanksgiving!
  • Wishing you all the joys that Thanksgiving brings, [Customer Name]. From our family to yours!

5 Marketing Messages to Celebrate Thanksgiving

Some businesses thrive by sending promotional messages around Thanksgiving. This approach is perfect for promoting special offers, particularly those related to the holiday theme.

  • Enjoy Thanksgiving without the hassle of cooking! We offer prepared meals available from [time] to [time].
  • Forget something? Get last-minute items with a 15% discount using code RELIEVED. Order here: [link]
  • As a token of thanks, enjoy 25% off your purchase with code THANKFUL25. Don’t delay; the offer is limited!
  • Hello, [Customer’s Name]! Grab 30% off from our early Black Friday sale as thanks. Use code THANKS30 before it expires!
  • We appreciate you, [Customer’s Name]! Here’s a 15% discount on your next order. Shop now: [link]

5 Lighthearted and Cozy Thanksgiving Notes

By mixing warmth or humor into our messages, we can create fun, positive interactions with customers. Here are some playful Thanksgiving message ideas.

  • Happy Thanksgiving! May your turkey be juicy and your family drama-free! Thanks for being with us.
  • Wishing you joy, warmth, and perhaps a second helping of pie! Happy Thanksgiving to a fantastic customer.
  • Remember, calories don’t count today; enjoy that slice of pie! We appreciate you.
  • On this holiday, we’re grateful for you, and of course, stretchy pants. Enjoy!
  • Happy Thanksgiving! May laughter, food, and family fill your day—without any work emails!

5 Brief Thanksgiving Greetings for Clients

Sometimes a short message says it all. These concise texts ensure our warm wishes reach many customers efficiently.

  • Happy Thanksgiving to our amazing customers. You’re a vital part of our story!
  • Happy Thanksgiving! Your support means the world to us.
  • May your Thanksgiving be joyful. Savor the food and family time!
  • Warm Thanksgiving greetings from our team at [Brand Name].
  • We hope your Thanksgiving is blessed with joy and gratitude.

5 Thanksgiving Wishes for Our Team

Expressing gratitude to employees is just as important. These messages show appreciation for their efforts and contributions.

  • Hello [Employee Name], wishing you a joyful Thanksgiving. Your hard work is highly valued by us.
  • To [Employee Name], Happy Thanksgiving! Your dedication is greatly appreciated.
  • Enjoy a wonderful Thanksgiving, [Employee Name]. We are grateful for all you do.
  • In this season of gratefulness, know that you’re a vital part of our team. Happy Thanksgiving!
  • Thank you for your hard work and dedication, team! Wishing everyone a joyful Thanksgiving.

These templates offer a variety of ways to express gratitude and connection during Thanksgiving, enriching relationships with both customers and team members.

5 Key Tips for Creating Impactful Thanksgiving Text Messages

  1. Find the Right Timing
     Timing matters when sending Thanksgiving text messages. To maximize impact, promotional messages should go out a few days before the holiday. This gives customers time to plan their purchases or consider special offers. For general Thanksgiving greetings, sending them a day before or the morning of the holiday is ideal. This approach ensures that our messages are timely and our customers feel appreciated.
  2. Personalize Each Message
     Adding a personal touch, such as using the customer’s name, makes each recipient feel valued. It shows we see them as individuals, not just transactions. Segmenting our audience also helps tailor the message for different groups. This strategy creates more meaningful interactions, fostering loyalty and satisfaction.
  3. Be Concise and Clear
     Given that SMS messages are limited to 160 characters, brevity is key. Our messages should focus on one clear message or offer. This clarity not only respects our customers’ time during the busy holiday season but also helps ensure the message is effective and easy to understand.
  4. Include a Strong Call to Action
     A good Thanksgiving message often includes a call to action (CTA). Whether it’s to check out a special offer on our website or engage with our brand in some way, a clear CTA helps drive customer action. This, combined with festive messaging, can lead to increased engagement and better results.
  5. Choose the Right Tone
     Our message tone should be warm, sincere, and suited to our brand and audience. Whether it’s formal or casual, the tone sets the stage for how the message is received. By aligning our tone with our brand identity, we enhance the effectiveness of our Thanksgiving text messages.

Using these strategies, we can craft Happy Thanksgiving messages that not only convey gratitude but also strengthen our relationships with customers..

Thanksgiving Text Messages to Send

Thanksgiving is a great time to let our customers know how much we value them. With a simple text, we can express our appreciation and build stronger connections. Crafting thoughtful messages helps in maintaining positive relationships and ensures that our brand stays on their minds.

Sending SMS is effective because it’s quick and widely read. Compared to emails, texts generally have higher open rates. This means our messages are more likely to be seen and appreciated by our audience.

Personalized Thanksgiving Text Messages

Personalizing messages makes a big difference. Here are some examples that add a personal touch:

  • Happy Thanksgiving [Customer Name]. We’re so lucky to work with awesome customers like you!
  • Hi [Customer Name]. THANK YOU for being part of our brand family. Happy Thanksgiving from all of us!
  • Hi [Customer Name]! Enjoy a Thanksgiving filled with laughter and warmth. Best wishes from the [Brand Name] family.

Promotional Thanksgiving Text Messages

Thanksgiving can also be an opportunity for promotional messages. Here are some ideas:

  • Happy Thanksgiving! Skip the cooking—we offer prepared turkeys and sides. Open today from [time] to [time].
  • Need a last-minute item? Order now and take 15% off with code RELIEVED.
  • Happy Thanksgiving! Enjoy 25% off your next purchase as our token of appreciation. Use code THANKFUL25.
  • Happy Thanksgiving, [Customer’s Name]! Get early access to Black Friday deals. Use code THANKS30.
  • Thankful for you, [Customer’s Name]! Here’s a 15% discount on your next order. Shop today: [link].

Warm & Humorous Thanksgiving Text Messages

A touch of humor or warmth in messages can create memorable interactions:

  • Happy Thanksgiving! May your turkey be moist and your in-laws be nice! We’re thankful for amazing customers like you!
  • Wishing you a Thanksgiving filled with laughter and pie! Thank you for being a great customer.
  • Happy Thanksgiving! Calories don’t count today—have that second slice of pie! We appreciate you!
  • Today, we’re thankful for you… and for stretchy pants. Enjoy your Thanksgiving!
  • Happy Thanksgiving! May your day be full of food, friends, and zero work emails.

Short Happy Thanksgiving Messages

Short messages are perfect for broad distribution:

  • Happy Thanksgiving to our wonderful customers. Thanks for being part of our journey!
  • Happy Thanksgiving! We appreciate you more than words can say.
  • We wish you a joyful Thanksgiving! Savor delicious food and family time.
  • Happy Thanksgiving from everyone at [Brand Name].
  • Wishing you a blessed Thanksgiving.

Thanksgiving Messages to Employees

Expressing gratitude to our employees is equally important:

  • Hi [Employee Name]. Happy Thanksgiving! Enjoy your holiday. We truly appreciate all your hard work.
  • Hi [Employee Name]. We’re glad to have dedicated employees like you. Happy Thanksgiving!
  • Wishing you and your family a happy Thanksgiving, [Employee Name]. Thanks for everything you do.
  • As we celebrate gratitude, know that you are a vital part of our team. Have a fantastic Thanksgiving.
  • Happy Thanksgiving, team! Your hard work is valued, and we’re grateful.

Best Practices for Crafting Effective Thanksgiving Texts

Here are some tips to make our Thanksgiving text messages impactful:

  1. Optimal Timing: Timing is key. Promotional messages work well a few days before Thanksgiving. General greetings should be sent a day before or on the morning of the holiday.
  2. Personalize: Include the customer’s name when possible. This shows individual appreciation. Segment audiences for relevant promotions too.
  3. Keep it Short: SMS messages are best kept concise. Stick to a clear and single message to avoid distractions.
  4. Clear Call to Action: Include a CTA to encourage site visits or use of discounts. It enhances the effectiveness of our Thanksgiving marketing.

By incorporating these best practices, our Thanksgiving text messages will leave a positive impact and strengthen our customer relationships during this festive season.

Thanksgiving Wishes for Colleagues or Your Boss

Whenever the holiday season rolls around, it’s a great opportunity to express our appreciation towards colleagues and bosses. These gestures foster a positive work environment and strengthen professional relationships. Here, we’ve included some thoughtful Happy Thanksgiving messages you might consider sending to your team or supervisor.

Type of Message

Usage

Expressing Gratitude

Appreciation for Leadership

Used to acknowledge a leader’s positive impact, ideal for managers or bosses.

Adding a Touch of Humor

Lighthearted messages meant to add fun, perfect for friends, colleagues, or anyone who enjoys humor during holidays.

Professional Wishes

Formal gratitude to acknowledge work contributions, suitable for work-related contexts or more professional settings.

Fostering Team Spirit

Messages that encourage unity and highlight teamwork, best for team-based or collaborative environments.

  • “Your vision and leadership have made a lasting impact on our team. Thank you for everything you do. Have a wonderful Thanksgiving!”
  • “Thank you for being an incredible leader and role model. We appreciate your guidance and wish you a relaxing and festive Thanksgiving.”

Adding a Touch of Humor:

  • “May your Thanksgiving be as great as the deals on Black Friday, and may your turkey be bigger than your workload!”

  • “Wishing you a Thanksgiving that’s as stress-free as possible—no deadlines, just pie!”
  • “May your holiday be filled with great food, good company, and absolutely no emails. Happy Thanksgiving!”

Professional Wishes:

  • “In this season of gratitude, we want to express our sincere thanks for all the hard work you do. Have a joyous Thanksgiving!”
  • “Your efforts and commitment make a huge difference. Thank you for everything. Happy Thanksgiving!”
  • “Wishing you a Thanksgiving full of joy and appreciation. Thank you for your continuous hard work and dedication.”
  • “As we reflect on all we’ve achieved this year, we want to thank you for your outstanding contributions. Wishing you a peaceful and happy Thanksgiving.”

Fostering Team Spirit:

  • “We are grateful for every team member who makes our workplace a better place. Thank you for your teamwork and dedication!”
  • “Thanksgiving is a time to reflect on the year’s accomplishments, and we couldn’t have done it without each of you. Cheers to more successes together!”
  • “We truly value each member of our team and the unique contributions you bring. Have a fantastic Thanksgiving, and thank you for being part of our success.”
  • “Our team is what makes us strong. Thank you for your hard work and collaboration. Let’s continue to achieve great things together. Happy Thanksgiving!”

Additional Tips for Sending Messages:

To ensure your Thanksgiving text messages resonate well, consider these elements:

  • Personalization: Whenever possible, personalize your message with the recipient’s name. This adds a personal touch showing that you value them individually.
  • Brevity and Clarity: Be concise and clear to ensure your message is easily understood during the busy holiday season.
  • Positive Tone: Maintain a warm and positive tone, as Thanksgiving is a time of joy and reflection.

Through these messages, we create meaningful interactions that foster loyalty and appreciation, strengthening bonds within our professional circles. Sharing gratitude not only uplifts spirits but also encourages an environment where everyone feels valued and supported.

Thanksgiving Wishes and Greetings for Friends

Thanksgiving is a wonderful time to express our gratitude to friends who enrich our lives. It’s about cherishing the bonds we have and showing appreciation for the special people around us. Crafting thoughtful thanksgiving messages can help convey our feelings in a meaningful way. Here, we offer some ideas to inspire your Thanksgiving greetings.

Short and Sweet Wishes

Sometimes less is more. Simple messages can often convey warmth and sincerity without being overly wordy. Consider sending:

  • “Wishing you a joyful Thanksgiving surrounded by loved ones!”
  • “Happy Thanksgiving! I’m so grateful for your friendship.”
  • “May your Thanksgiving be filled with happiness and laughter.”

Heartfelt Messages

For those times when you want to express more depth, heartfelt messages can help you share how much your friends mean to you. You might try:

  • “On this day of thanks, I’m reminded of how grateful I am to have you in my life. Happy Thanksgiving!”
  • “Thanksgiving is a time to reflect on blessings, and you are one of the greatest ones in my life.”
  • “Your friendship fills my heart with joy and my life with meaning. Happy Thanksgiving, dear friend!”

Funny and Lighthearted Greetings

If you and your friends enjoy a good laugh, adding humor to your messages can lighten the mood and add a unique touch:

  • “Happy Turkey Day! May your stuffing be tasty and your pumpkin pie even tastier!”
  • “Thanksgiving: A time to count blessings, not calories. Enjoy!”
  • “Gobble ’til you wobble! Cheers to a fun and filling Thanksgiving!”

Inspirational Quotes

Quotes can be a nice addition to your Happy Thanksgiving messages, providing wisdom and encouragement:

  • “Gratitude turns what we have into enough.”
  • “Thanksgiving is a time of togetherness and gratitude.”
  • “Thankfulness is the quickest path to joy.”

Expressing Gratitude

Letting your friends know how much you appreciate them is essential. Here are some ways to do so:

  • “Thank you for always being there and making life beautiful. Enjoy your Thanksgiving!”
  • “Grateful for moments shared, memories made, and the wonderful friend you are.”
  • “Happy Thanksgiving! I’m incredibly thankful for your support and kindness.”

Creative Ideas to Celebrate Virtually

In times when distance separates us, virtual greetings can bring us closer. Consider these ideas:

  • Video Message: Record a short video expressing your gratitude and share it with your friends.
  • Recipe Swap: Exchange Thanksgiving recipes and cook them together over a video call.
  • Virtual Feast: Arrange a time to eat together virtually, sharing the Thanksgiving spirit from afar.

Greeting Card Suggestions

If you enjoy traditional greetings, a handwritten card can be a special touch. Here are some suggestions to include:

  • Front of Card: “Wishing you a Happy Thanksgiving!”
  • Inside the Card: “May your home be filled with the laughter of friends, the love of family, and the joys of the season.”

Table Setting Card Ideas

For those hosting Thanksgiving meals, adding a personal greeting card to table settings can be a delightful surprise:

  • Simple Note: “Thankful for your presence today. Enjoy the feast!”
  • Personal Message: Insert a short note tailored to each guest’s unique qualities or contributions.

Writing thoughtful Thanksgiving wishes and greetings for friends can make the holiday even more special. Whether your words are simple or elaborate, focusing on sincerity and gratitude makes them meaningful.

Heartfelt Notes for Family During Thanksgiving

Thanksgiving is a special time for us to honor our families and express gratitude. Sharing thanksgiving messages and thoughtful words with our loved ones can make the holiday feel even more meaningful. Here are some ways to convey our feelings and appreciation.

  • We may be a chaotic family, but I’m grateful you put up with me anyway. Happy Thanksgiving!

  • May the turkey leg be yours this Thanksgiving.
  • Happy Thanksgiving to the people who make me thankful to be me.
  • May the wishbone snap in your favor this Thanksgiving.
  • Having somewhere to go is home. Having someone to love is family. Having both is a blessing. – Unknown

  • Happy Thanksgiving. As I take time to give thanks for many blessings in my life, I want to let you know how grateful I am that you are one of them.
  • Today is the time to be thankful and remember good times. I’m thankful for a lot of things, but I’m most thankful for you. Happy Thanksgiving!

Send personalized Thanksgiving messages to customers, employees, and loved ones today! Sign up now and build lasting connections.
Register Now

FAQ 

What is the best wish for Thanksgiving?

The best wish for Thanksgiving is one that expresses gratitude and warmth. A great example is: “Wishing you a joyful Thanksgiving filled with love, laughter, and gratitude.”

How do you say "Happy Thanksgiving" in text?

You can simply text: “Happy Thanksgiving!” or personalize it with something like: “Wishing you a Happy Thanksgiving, filled with love and happiness.”

How do you wish Family Happy Thanksgiving?

For family, a heartfelt message could be: “Happy Thanksgiving to my wonderful family! I’m so grateful for each and every one of you.”

How do you say Happy Thanksgiving in business?

In business, you can say: “Happy Thanksgiving! We’re thankful for your continued support and partnership.” It’s professional yet expresses appreciation.

What is an example of a work-appropriate Thanksgiving message?

An example of a work-appropriate message is: “Happy Thanksgiving! Wishing you a peaceful and joyous holiday. Thank you for your hard work and dedication.”

How do you send Thanksgiving text messages to friends?

For friends, you might text: “Happy Thanksgiving! I’m so grateful for your friendship and all the amazing memories we’ve shared.”

What is a professional Thanksgiving message?

A professional message could be: “Wishing you a Happy Thanksgiving! Your continued trust and partnership are truly appreciated. Enjoy a wonderful holiday!”

What are short Thanksgiving text messages to send to friends?

A short Thanksgiving message for friends could be: “Happy Thanksgiving, friend! Wishing you lots of love and happiness today and always!”

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<h2><span class="ez-toc-section" id="Introduction"></span>Introduction<span class="ez-toc-section-end"></span></h2><p>As Thanksgiving approaches, it’s the perfect time to send warm wishes to friends and loved ones who can’t be with you at the table. Whether you want to share a heartfelt message or add a touch of humor, expressing your gratitude through a Thanksgiving greeting is a great way to spread joy. From funny one-liners to thoughtful notes, we’ve compiled over 90 creative Thanksgiving message ideas. Use these to connect with family, friends, or anyone special this holiday season and show them how much they mean to you.</p><p>SMSLocal.com stands out as a prominent platform for bulk SMS services, known for its reliability and efficiency. Our system caters to both businesses and individual users, seamlessly supporting their communication needs, whether for marketing, alerts, or personal messages. We are a trusted partner for organizations around the globe, ensuring effective communication across many industries and applications.</p><h3><span class="ez-toc-section" id="Key_Takeaways"></span>Key Takeaways:<span class="ez-toc-section-end"></span></h3><ul><li><strong>User-Friendly:</strong> Easy to use platform with quick setup and operation.</li><li><strong>Versatile Applications:</strong> Ideal for marketing, notifications, and personal messaging.</li><li><strong>Global Trust:</strong> Trusted by a wide range of industries with a strong global reputation.</li></ul><h2><span class="ez-toc-section" id="Why_Send_Thanksgiving_Text_Messages_to_Customers"></span>Why Send Thanksgiving Text Messages to Customers?<span class="ez-toc-section-end"></span></h2><p><img fetchpriority="high" fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" class="alignnone size-full wp-image-90400" src="https://www.smslocal.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Why-Send-Thanksgiving-Text-Messages-to-Customers.webp" alt="Why Send Thanksgiving Text Messages to Customers" width="1280" height="720" srcset="https://www.smslocal.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Why-Send-Thanksgiving-Text-Messages-to-Customers.webp 1280w, https://www.smslocal.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Why-Send-Thanksgiving-Text-Messages-to-Customers-300x169.webp 300w, https://www.smslocal.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Why-Send-Thanksgiving-Text-Messages-to-Customers-1024x576.webp 1024w, https://www.smslocal.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Why-Send-Thanksgiving-Text-Messages-to-Customers-768x432.webp 768w, https://www.smslocal.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Why-Send-Thanksgiving-Text-Messages-to-Customers-600x338.webp 600w" sizes="(max-width: 1280px) 100vw, 1280px" /></p><p>Thanksgiving provides a unique opportunity to express gratitude to our customers and strengthen our business relationships. Simple <a href="https://www.smslocal.com/blog/block-text-messages/" data-wpil-monitor-id="1225">text messages</a> can communicate appreciation and enhance connections in a meaningful way. Our customers play a vital role in our success, and letting them know this during a time of gratitude can reinforce positive feelings and build loyalty.</p><p>In a busy and competitive market, staying connected with customers is essential. Happy Thanksgiving message serve as a gentle reminder of how much we value their support. By doing this, we not only acknowledge their role in our story but also keep our brand in their minds in a pleasant and memorable way.</p><p><strong>The Advantages of SMS Communication</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Immediate Reach</strong>: SMS messages are typically read within minutes of being received, ensuring our gratitude messages are promptly seen.</li><li><strong>High Engagement</strong>: With high open and response rates, SMS offers an effective way to engage customers directly without overwhelming them.</li><li><strong>Personal Touch</strong>: Personalizing messages by including the customer’s name or referencing past interactions makes the communication feel more genuine and considerate.</li></ul><p><strong>Building Stronger Relationships Through Gratitude</strong><strong><br /></strong>Thanking customers fosters goodwill and strengthens emotional bonds, boosting loyalty and encouraging positive word-of-mouth. Personalizing messages shows customers they’re valued, not just transactions.</p><p><strong>Enhancing Brand Image and Loyalty</strong><strong><br /></strong>Gratitude enhances a brand’s image, making it more approachable and human. Sending festive, heartfelt messages creates positive associations and strengthens customer loyalty.</p><p><strong>Strategic Timing and Messaging</strong><strong><br /></strong>Timing matters—sending Thanksgiving messages close to the holiday sets a warm tone for future interactions. <script>
        function openTab(evt, tabId) {
            evt.preventDefault();

            var i, tabcontent, tablinks;
            tabcontent = document.getElementsByClassName("ff_ttf-panel");
            for (i = 0; i < tabcontent.length; i++) {
                tabcontent[i].classList.remove("vc_active");
            }
            tablinks = document.getElementsByClassName("ff_ttf-tab");
            for (i = 0; i < tablinks.length; i++) {
                tablinks[i].classList.remove("vc_active");
            }
            document.getElementById(tabId).classList.add("vc_active");
            if (evt.type === "change") {
                document.querySelector(`.ff_ttf-tab a[href="#${tabId}"]`).parentNode.classList.add("vc_active");
            } else {
                evt.currentTarget.parentNode.classList.add("vc_active");
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            var tabLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.ff_ttf-tab a');
            tabLinks.forEach(function(link) {
                link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    openTab(e, this.getAttribute('href').substring(1));
                });
            });

            // Search functionality
            var searchInputbox = document.getElementById('country-search-input');
            searchInputbox.addEventListener('input', function() {
                var searchTerm = this.value.toLowerCase();
                var found = false;

                // Remove previous highlights
                document.querySelectorAll('.highlight').forEach(function(el) {
                    el.classList.remove('highlight');
                });

                if (searchTerm.length > 0) {
                    document.querySelectorAll('.image-box').forEach(function(container) {
                        var countryName = container.querySelector('p').textContent.toLowerCase();
                        if (countryName.includes(searchTerm)) {
                            found = true;
                            container.classList.add('highlight');
                            var tabId = container.closest('.ff_ttf-panel').id;
                            openTab({ preventDefault: function() {} }, tabId);
                            container.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                        }
                    });
                }

                if (!found) {
                    // If no country is found, you might want to display a message or reset the view
                    console.log('No matching country found');
                }
            });
        });
    </script>


</body>

                    data: {
                        action: 'send_sms_message',
                        security: '285338a4a7',
                        mobile: fullNumber,
                        country_code: countryCode
                    },
                    beforeSend: function () {
                        messageElement.text('Sending SMS...');
                        messageElement.css('color', 'black');
                        sendButton.prop('disabled', true);
                    },
                    success: function (response) {
                        messageElement.text(response.data);
                        if (response.success) {
                            $('#mobile').val('');
                            messageElement.css('color', 'green');

                            messageElement.css('color', 'red');
                            if (response.data.includes('already been used') || 
                                response.data.includes('IP has been blocked')) {
                                sendButton.prop('disabled', true);

                        }
                        sendButton.prop('disabled', false);
                    },
                    error: function () {

						const lazyloadBackgrounds = document.querySelectorAll( `.e-con.e-parent:not(.e-lazyloaded)` );
						const lazyloadBackgroundObserver = new IntersectionObserver( ( entries ) => {
							entries.forEach( ( entry ) => {
								if ( entry.isIntersecting ) {
									let lazyloadBackground = entry.target;
									if( lazyloadBackground ) {
										lazyloadBackground.classList.add( 'e-lazyloaded' );
									}
									lazyloadBackgroundObserver.unobserve( entry.target );
								}
							});
						}, { rootMargin: '200px 0px 200px 0px' } );
						lazyloadBackgrounds.forEach( ( lazyloadBackground ) => {
							lazyloadBackgroundObserver.observe( lazyloadBackground );
						} );
					};
					const events = [
						'DOMContentLoaded',
						'elementor/lazyload/observe',
					];
					events.forEach( ( event ) => {
						document.addEventListener( event, lazyloadRunObserver );
					} );
				} )();
